```{r}
connected_type = paste(eco_type, "connected", size_effects_selected) %>% print()
print_dominance(connected_type)

unconnected_type = paste(eco_type, "unconnected", size_effects_selected) %>% print()
print_dominance(unconnected_type)
```

<details>
<summary>**Click to view the effect size (connected vs unconnected) with Hedge's d**</summary>

```{r}
"Hedge's d"
```

```{r}
for(time_point_i in 2:4){
    
    print(paste("Time point ", time_point_i))
    
    p = ds_species_effect_sizes_d %>%
      filter(ecosystem_type == connected_type,
             time_point == time_point_i,
             species != "Eug") %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = species,
                 y = effect_size)) + 
      geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = lower_95_CI, ymax = upper_95_CI)) + 
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted") +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
            panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
            legend.position = legend_position,
            legend.key.width = unit(legend_width_cm, "cm"))
    
    print(p)
    
  }
```

</details>
